name: ui-apexpages-action-root-runtime

evidence.notes: Root Action value is constructed with a nondefault Visualforce expression and cloned into an independent runtime value.

args: ApexPages.Action action=new ApexPages.Action('{!rootAction}'); System.assertNotEquals(null,action); ApexPages.Action cloned=(ApexPages.Action)action.clone(); System.assertNotEquals(null,cloned); System.assertEquals('{!rootAction}',action.getExpression()); System.assertEquals(action.getExpression(),cloned.getExpression());

salesforceExclusionReason: This fixture proves only deterministic local ApexPages.Action value and clone behavior and makes zero Salesforce Visualforce parity claim.
